tasks.short: Select suitable mechanical designs, equipment and installation plans

steps.what: Select mechanical designs, installation equipment or plans after checking site and applicable requirements

tasks.design: Retain selection with the installer and responsible design specialists. Consult {DOCS} drawings and {OTHER}, installation-design tools, while checking actual site conditions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Suitability depends on structural, architectural and environmental conditions at the site.
tasks.enabler_now: Current drawings and design tools support selection without establishing that the actual site conforms.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain structures, access restrictions and conflicting requirements.
tasks.human_edge: The installer recognises when the site differs from the plan and requests specialist assessment.

reach.task: Resolve design applicability and structural questions
reach.learn: Which site findings prevent routine selection

evidence.claim: Site-specific installation selection needs contextual technical judgement; operational monitoring software does not establish design suitability.

assumptions: Boundary is selection and design handoff, not structural certification or installation execution.

Installer observes and records site conditions in s1; engineer and manufacturers supply drawings, requirements and specifications. The installer checks identities, revisions, dimensions, constraints and unresolved questions within the same time. No free structurally-suitable or code-compliant flag is assumed.
Use existing drawings and installation-design tools first.
Incremental upkeep is zero because no new design-selection engine is introduced.
research_questions: Which site findings require new specialist evidence before equipment or plan selection?

already_counted.description: Site assessment, requirements checks and selection

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross and net saving. Site-specific selection retains its time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain PV operation, performance and maintenance records

steps.what: Verify system identity, monitoring sources and actual maintenance records before compilation
Compile system operation, performance and maintenance records from the checked sources
Check compiled records, resolve missing entries and accept the maintained system record

tasks.design: Use native reporting in {OTHER}, the inverter-monitoring portal, and link checked maintenance entries in {DOCS}. Keep asset mapping, actual service-record capture and gap review with the installer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Monitoring values and maintenance records may be copied into a separate system-history document.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest identifies inverter portals with yield, status, event lists and scheduled reports.
tasks.still_hard: Correct system identity, communication gaps, changed equipment and incomplete service records.
tasks.human_edge: The installer checks whether the history represents the actual installation and completed maintenance.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated history compilation while keeping source and completeness checks.

reach.task: Explain maintenance-record completion and follow-up routes
reach.learn: Which missing records require contact with the servicing technician

evidence.claim: SMA Sunny Portal provides PV yield and status, event lists, scheduled reports and alarms.
Combining those existing monitoring records with checked maintenance fields is an unmeasured design scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is maintaining the system history, not performing maintenance or diagnosing a physical fault.

Existing inverter monitoring produces timestamped yield, status and event records; servicing technician produces actual service date, asset identifier, work performed and service-document reference. Installer verifies and captures site and inverter identifiers, period, time zone, units, source mapping and service fields in s1. This capture and mapping time is retained.
S2 uses those sources only; missing telemetry or service evidence produces a gap for manual follow-up in s3, never inferred maintenance completion or a healthy-system flag.
Test native portal reports first; existing scheduled reporting runtime earns no labour saving. Savings require observed separate manual compilation.
research_questions: Can native reports remove manual compilation while preserving asset identity and visible source gaps?

already_counted.description: Mapping, service-field capture and completeness review

incremental.description: Maintain source mappings and review changed equipment or reporting fields
Maintain portal access and document links

approvals.approved_version: Exact system identity, period, compiled values, service references and recorded gaps; source or content changes require renewed review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+0+25=60; gross 40 minus focal upkeep 8 gives net 32 in an E1 manual-compilation scenario. Range 0-5 allows existing scheduled reports, sparse maintenance records and source gaps.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated PV-history compilation while retaining site-specific selection and source checks.
reach: Resolve site questions with installation engineers
skills_to_grow: Maintain explicit gaps in system histories
role.ambitious_version: An installer with traceable system records who retains responsibility for actual site conditions and installation choices.
